items.question: How safe is Iceland?
items.answer: We felt extremely safe. The bigger risks are environmental rather than social: weather, wind, road conditions and underestimating how isolated stretches of the route can be.

items.question: What could ruin my stay in Iceland?
items.answer: Building an itinerary with no slack. Bad weather can erase a viewpoint, slow a drive or wipe out an aurora plan. Give Iceland enough room to misbehave.
